record.field: Validar ordenes de entrega shopify barcelona

# ============================================================ # Acción planificada: validación automática pickings tipo 346 # Odoo 17 — compatible con safe_eval (sin `with`, sin STORE_ATTR) # ============================================================
PICKING_TYPE_ID = 346 LOOKBACK_HOURS = 24 MAX_PICKINGS = 100
start_date = datetime.datetime.utcnow() - dateutil.relativedelta.relativedelta(hours=LOOKBACK_HOURS)
domain = [ ('picking_type_id', '=', PICKING_TYPE_ID), ('state', 'in', ('confirmed', 'assigned')), ('create_date', '>=', start_date), ]
Picking = env['stock.picking'].sudo() MoveLine = env['stock.move.line'].sudo() pickings = Picking.search(domain, order='create_date asc, id asc', limit=MAX_PICKINGS)
log("=== PICKINGS ENCONTRADOS: %d ===" % len(pickings))
# Reserva en lote (1 sola llamada para todos los 'confirmed') to_assign = pickings.filtered(lambda p: p.state == 'confirmed') if to_assign: to_assign.action_assign()
ok = 0 fail = 0
for picking in pickings: name = picking.name sp = "sp_pick_%d" % picking.id # nombre único por picking env.cr.execute("SAVEPOINT %s" % sp)
try: # ---- 1. Forzar cantidad realizada = demanda ---- new_lines = [] for move in picking.move_ids: demand = move.product_uom_qty or 0.0 if demand <= 0: continue
if not move.move_line_ids: new_lines.append({ 'move_id' : move.id, 'picking_id' : picking.id, 'product_id' : move.product_id.id, 'product_uom_id' : move.product_uom.id, 'location_id' : move.location_id.id, 'location_dest_id': move.location_dest_id.id, 'quantity' : demand, }) else: # Concentrar la demanda en la primera línea, resto a 0 # (sin asignación directa de atributo: usamos write) lines = move.move_line_ids first = lines[0] rest = lines[1:] if first.quantity != demand: first.write({'quantity': demand}) if rest: rest.write({'quantity': 0.0})
if new_lines: MoveLine.create(new_lines)
# ---- 2. Validar ---- res = picking.with_context(skip_sms=True).button_validate()
# ---- 3. Dispatcher genérico de wizards ---- if isinstance(res, dict) and res.get('res_model') and res.get('res_id'): wiz = env[res['res_model']].sudo().browse(res['res_id']) if hasattr(wiz, 'process'): wiz.with_context(skip_sms=True).process() elif hasattr(wiz, 'button_validate'): wiz.with_context(skip_sms=True).button_validate()
# ---- 4. Auditar ---- picking.invalidate_recordset(['state']) if picking.state == 'done': picking.message_post(body="✅ Validación automática completada (cantidad = demanda).") log("[%s] VALIDADO" % name) ok += 1 else: picking.message_post(body="⚠️ No completado. Estado final: %s" % picking.state) log("[%s] NO VALIDADO | Estado: %s" % (name, picking.state), level='warning') fail += 1
env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT %s" % sp)
except Exception as e: # Rollback del bloque y seguir con el siguiente picking env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT %s" % sp) env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT %s" % sp) fail += 1 log("[%s] ERROR: %s" % (name, e), level='error') try: picking.sudo().message_post(body="❌ Error en validación automática: %s" % e) except Exception as post_err: log("[%s] message_post falló: %s" % (name, post_err), level='error')
log("=== RESUMEN: %d OK | %d FAIL ===" % (ok, fail))
